Role.title: Role
Role.description: RBAC role definitions and module permission scopes. Single source of truth for permissions — User references this via role_id, never duplicates a role label or permission flags locally.

permissions.description: Boolean flags per module. This is the ONLY place permissions are defined.

is_system_role.description: True for built-in roles; prevents deletion

Site.title: Site
Site.description: Master facility configuration entity for multi-tenant parking sites

site_name.description: Display name of the site facility

domain_whitelist.description: Allowed email domains for auto employee registration

pricing.description: All money fields are integers in minor currency units (paise). Never use floats for money.

User.title: User
User.description: User profile entity. Document ID = Firebase Auth UID. role_id and assigned_sites are the ONLY sources of permission/scope truth — do not add a separate 'role' label or a singular 'site_id' field, both create ambiguity with role_id/assigned_sites.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID, matches document ID

role_id.description: FK -> /roles/{roleId}. This is the single source of permission truth.

assigned_sites.description: FK[] -> /sites/{siteId}. This is the single source of site-access truth. Empty array if site_scope_type is ALL_SITES.

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: Registered vehicle asset profile. Document ID in Firestore MUST be the normalized_vehicle_number itself (not an opaque auto-ID) — this is what enforces one record per physical vehicle across the whole system. Do not add site_id or user_id here; vehicles can move between employees/sites over their lifetime, so ownership/site-assignment belongs on Registration instead.

normalized_vehicle_number.description: Also the Firestore document ID. Clean uppercase alphanumeric plate, e.g. 'KA01EX5544'

vehicle_brand.description: Make and model, e.g. 'Tesla Model Y'

active_registration_id.description: FK -> /registrations/{id}, null if no approved registration currently active

Registration.title: Registration
Registration.description: Employee vehicle registration request and authorization pass. Firestore document ID must be an auto-generated ID (Firestore addDoc), never a sequential string like 'REG-4019' — sequential IDs cause write hotspotting at scale. Employee details are captured as an explicit point-in-time snapshot, distinct from the live user_id FK.

user_id.description: FK -> /users/{uid}. Live source of truth for employee identity.

vehicle_number.description: Raw display-format plate at time of registration

snapshot.description: Explicit point-in-time copy of employee details for audit purposes. NOT live data — do not sync this back from User; if fields change on User, this stays as it was at registration time.

InventorySlot.title: InventorySlot
InventorySlot.description: Physical or mechanical parking slot pallet. Document ID format is a naturally-sharded composite like 'B1-P01-S01' (this is fine to keep, unlike Registration's IDs). CRITICAL: any write that changes 'status' MUST happen inside a Firestore runTransaction() that re-reads status first and aborts if it isn't in the expected prior state — this is the only thing that prevents two concurrent gate-entry events from double-booking the same slot. Never implement status changes as a plain read-then-write.

normalized_vehicle_number.description: FK -> /vehicles/{normalized_vehicle_number}, null when VACANT. Never store a raw plate string here.

ParkingLog.title: ParkingLog
ParkingLog.description: Audit entry and exit log for parked vehicles, linked by FK to both slot and vehicle rather than raw strings.

ValetTicket.title: ValetTicket
ValetTicket.description: Valet guest check-in, key tag, and vehicle retrieval record

SiteInvoice.title: SiteInvoice
SiteInvoice.description: SaaS multi-tenancy invoices and billing records. Money fields are integers in minor units (paise), matching Site.pricing — never floats.

SecurityAuditLog.title: SecurityAuditLog
SecurityAuditLog.description: Cryptographic audit trail. prev_hash/entry_hash form a SHA-256 HMAC chain — each new entry's prev_hash must equal the previous entry's entry_hash, so the sequence is tamper-evident. Do not omit the hash chain fields.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous log entry, forms the chain

/roles/{roleId}.description: Role-based access control definitions — the single source of permission truth

/sites/{siteId}.description: Master facility configuration, domain whitelists, and pricing

/users/{uid}.description: User profiles, document ID = Firebase Auth UID, references roles via role_id

/vehicles/{normalized_vehicle_number}.description: Vehicle asset profiles. Document ID IS the normalized plate — enforces uniqueness natively

/registrations/{registrationId}.description: Employee vehicle registration requests, auto-generated document IDs

/inventory_slots/{slotId}.description: Real-time parking slots. Status changes require runTransaction() — see entity description

/parking_logs/{logId}.description: Gate ANPR camera entry and exit telemetry, linked to slots and vehicles by FK

/valet_tickets/{ticketId}.description: Valet tickets, key tags, and guest vehicle retrieval passes

/invoices/{invoiceId}.description: SaaS multi-tenancy billing invoices, money as integer paise

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Cryptographic security and compliance audit trail with SHA-256 HMAC chain

implementation_notes.naming_convention: snake_case for ALL field names across ALL entities, with no exceptions. Do not mix in camelCase fields like 'ticketNumber' or 'createdAt' anywhere in the implementation.
implementation_notes.concurrency: InventorySlot.status transitions MUST use Firestore runTransaction(), not a plain updateDoc(). This is the primary defense against double-booked slots from concurrent gate events.
implementation_notes.money: All monetary values are integers in minor currency units (paise for INR). Never use floating-point numbers for money fields.
implementation_notes.document_ids: Use Firestore auto-generated IDs for Registration, ParkingLog, ValetTicket, SiteInvoice, and SecurityAuditLog. Use the normalized_vehicle_number itself as the document ID for Vehicle. Use naturally-sharded composite strings (e.g. 'B1-P01-S01') for InventorySlot. Never use sequential IDs like 'REG-4019'.
implementation_notes.permissions: Permissions are defined only in Role.permissions. User.role_id is the only link to a role. Do not add a role label, permission booleans, or a singular site_id field directly on User — assigned_sites and site_scope_type are the only site-access fields.
